entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. To place a new order, press 1. For technical support, press 2. For returns or exchanges, press 3.
THREE! JUST GET ME TO A PERSON!
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return this helmet I bought! This is my third time calling, and your online portal is a joke! I want this handled now or I'm getting your manager on the line.
I'm very sorry to hear about the trouble you've had. I can definitely help you with a return. Could I please get your order number to start?
It's VF-90210. And just so we're clear, the box is unopened. It's been sitting here forever. The color is completely wrong and it's useless to me. I expect a full refund, no questions asked.
Understood. Thank you for that order number. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the Trail Helmet here from about 75 days ago.
Yeah, 75 days. Your policy is 90 days, I checked! Are you going to do this or am I going to have to write a review about how you people try to weasel out of your own policies? This is ridiculous!
Sir, there's absolutely no need for that. You are completely correct, and you are well within the 90-day return window. I can approve this return for you immediately.
Wait, really? You're just... approving it?

Yes, of course. Our main priority is rider satisfaction and safety, and if you're not happy with the helmet, we are happy to take it back. I've just processed the return authorization. I'm emailing a prepaid shipping label to you right now.
Oh. Okay. Well... that's a full refund, right?

Yes, a full refund to your original payment method. Just pack the helmet in a shipping box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days.
Huh. Alright then. That was... actually easy. Thanks, Isaac.
You're very welcome. I'm glad I could resolve this for you quickly. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a safe ride.
